info.title: Estate Jewelry Intake Assistant
info.summary: This is NOT an appraisal. Concept / early access, not a live service.
info.description:
This is NOT an appraisal. Concept / early access, not a live service.

Describes a hypothetical intake draft for independent jewelers. A customer would upload photos of estate jewelry. A draft sheet would list item type as it appears, metal stamps that can be read, stone count and type as guesses, condition notes, and questions for the customer. A credentialed jeweler would review the draft.

The draft would not be a value, a grade, or a determination of what the piece is. This document is hosted on static GitHub Pages. POST /intake-draft is not implemented. Calling it does not look at a photo. The status document that is actually published is status.json, with status concept and accepting waitlist.

There are no customers and no live results. Do not send photos.
